purpose: Eliminate the single-feature shortcut observed in v1. Generated non-NULL repair classes must require conjunctions of multiple residual dimensions.
anti_shortcut_requirements: at least one training world has best_base_capability=0 but correct action NULL because frontier_complete=0
at least one training world has best_base_capability=1 but correct action NULL because evidence_cost is already low
every generated non-NULL class predicate complexity must be exactly 2
no single atomic predicate may exactly identify a non-NULL action class
heldout_protocol: include EXPAND, REFINE, INCOMPLETE_NULL, and EFFICIENT_NULL worlds
select action from baseline residual only
seal all actions before repair outcomes
execute TREATMENT / WRONG / NULL / fixed-more-compute controls
cold-process restore ontology and classify a ninth world
